parts.title: A Cry Behind the Fence
parts.text: Tara, Marcus, and Sofia were walking home from school. They heard a thin cry behind a fence. A **stray** dog was hiding under a bush. He was cold and wet, and he was all alone. “We have to **rescue** him,” said Tara.

parts.title: Making a Friend
parts.text: The dog looked **shaggy** and **scruffy**, with mud in his fur. Marcus felt **hesitant** because he was not sure the dog would be friendly. Sofia sat on the ground and spoke softly to **comfort** him. The dog gave a little **yelp** and crept out. Then he began to **nuzzle** her hand.

parts.title: A Safe Place
parts.text: The children took him to the animal shelter. A kind worker gave him a bath and a bed in a warm **kennel**. His tail began to **wag**. “He is so **grateful**,” said Sofia. The worker said the children could visit every week. They were **overjoyed**.

parts.title: A Good Day
parts.text: Tara, Marcus, and Sofia walked home slowly. They had not planned to help a dog that day, but they were glad they stopped to listen. Sometimes a small kindness can change a whole day for someone.
